terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.description: The rules for using InterviewLike's job-search workspace.

service.title: The service
service.body: InterviewLike helps you discover opportunities, track applications, organize documents, and use AI-assisted editing tools. Features may evolve as the product develops.

account.title: Your account
account.body: Provide accurate registration information, protect your credentials, and tell us promptly if you believe your account has been compromised. You are responsible for activity performed through your account.

use.title: Acceptable use
use.body: Do not misuse the service, interfere with its operation, access another person's data, upload unlawful content, or use automated access in a way that harms the product or other users.

ai.title: AI-assisted content
ai.body: AI suggestions can be incomplete or inaccurate. Review generated content before submitting applications or making career decisions. You remain responsible for the documents and information you use.

availability.title: Availability and accounts
availability.body: We work to keep the service reliable, but availability is not guaranteed. We may restrict or close accounts that violate these terms, while allowing users to delete their own account through Security settings.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: We may update these terms when the product or applicable requirements change. Material updates will be communicated in the application before they take effect.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How InterviewLike handles account, job, document, and AI-workspace data.

collection.title: Information we collect
collection.body: We process account details, authentication information, saved jobs, application status, documents, tags, conversation history, preferences, and technical data needed to operate and secure the service.

use.title: How information is used
use.body: Information is used to provide the workspace, keep your content synchronized, personalize product behavior, protect accounts, troubleshoot failures, and communicate service-related updates.

sharing.title: Service providers
sharing.body: Data may be processed by infrastructure, authentication, email, job-search, and AI providers only as needed to deliver the requested feature. We do not sell personal information.

ai.title: AI context
ai.body: The active document, conversation, and any text you add in the context field are sent for generation. Clear the context field when that background should no longer be included in future editor requests.

retention.title: Retention and security
retention.body: We retain information while your account is active and as needed for security, recovery, and legal obligations. We use access controls and encrypted transport, but no system can guarantee absolute security.

rights.title: Your choices
rights.body: You can update account and notification preferences, remove jobs and documents, and delete your account from Security settings. Additional export and retention controls will appear there as they become available.
